item.title: Ask HN: How to make a tool like cURL that works with an EDGE connection?
item.summary: I would really like to hear your thoughts on whether this is even possible, at least in theory. Even if it’s not possible, I’m curious to learn more and find out why. If it is possible, what do I need to take into account? I’m looking forward to links to articles, guides, or documents that will help me understand how to implement this, or an explanation in simple terms. I’d love to hear your thoughts on this :) Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49344754 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
